title: Ulyana and the Recipe
premise: Ivo Amberdale has survived high school by being forgettable—until a group chat called 'the Recipe' starts posting predictions that come true with unsettling precision. Tracing the messages to Ulyana, a transfer student who vanished from the school two years ago under circumstances the board quietly erased, Ivo realizes the predictions are her way of reaching out from wherever she is. As the chat's final prophecy names a date and a name—his own—Ivo must dig up what really happened to her, expose the cover-up, and decide how much of his safe, invisible life he's willing to burn to give one erased girl back her story.
about_author: K. M. Amberdale grew up in a small river town where everyone knew everyone's business except the things that mattered most. They write stories about quiet kids who discover that silence is never neutral.

chapters.title: Locker Shut
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. A routine day establishes his survival rules: head down, grades up, never draw attention as the only out kid in a town of nine hundred. The emotional beat is controlled loneliness—he's made peace with invisibility, or tells himself he has.

chapters.title: Nine Hundred Strangers
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. At a town assembly honoring the school board, Ivo notices a gap in the yearbook display—a page cleanly missing. That night, an unknown number adds him to a group chat called 'the Recipe.' First message: a prediction about tomorrow's fire drill. Beat: unease disguised as curiosity.

chapters.title: The First Prediction
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The fire drill happens exactly as posted, down to the minute. He screenshots everything, tells no one, and tests the chat with a question. It answers with something only he knows: the words carved inside his locker door. Beat: the vertigo of being truly seen.

chapters.title: Ulyana
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Researching the chat leads him to a name scratched out of every record: Ulyana Voss, a student who transferred away two years ago—or didn't. His history teacher goes pale when asked and changes the subject. Beat: first taste of institutional stonewalling.

chapters.title: What the Board Buried
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV, with a flashback fragment in Ulyana's voice delivered via the chat. Ivo finds a redacted incident report referencing a basement lab wing closed the same semester Ulyana disappeared. Beat: the thrill of a real secret curdling into dread.

chapters.title: Allies and Liabilities
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. He cautiously recruits Dev, a skeptical classmate who runs the school's archive club. Dev thinks it's a hoax until the chat predicts Dev's own detention before it's assigned. Beat: reluctant partnership, the relief of not carrying it alone.

chapters.title: The Basement Wing
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The two break into the sealed wing and find a classroom frozen mid-lesson, Ulyana's handwriting on the whiteboard, and a locked cabinet labeled with the Recipe's exact name. Beat: awe shadowed by the sense of walking through someone's interrupted life.

chapters.title: Someone Is Watching
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. A janitor reports them; Vice Principal Calloway gives Ivo a too-gentle warning about 'rumors that hurt people.' That night the chat sends its first warning: STOP ASKING. Beat: fear arriving on schedule, exactly as predicted.

chapters.title: Ulyana's Notebook
chapters.summary: Alternating POV begins: Ulyana's recovered notebook entries describe experiments she was recruited into, and her growing realization that students who complained were 'transferred.' Beat: her voice—wry, fierce, increasingly afraid—becomes the book's second heartbeat.

chapters.title: The Price of Survival
chapters.summary: Ulyana's notebook POV. She documents the bargain she was offered: stay silent, get a future; speak up, become nobody. She chooses to copy evidence anyway. Beat: tragic courage—the reader now knows what her choice cost.

chapters.title: Calloway's Version
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Confronting Calloway privately, Ivo hears a rehearsed story about a troubled girl whose family 'wanted privacy.' But Calloway's hands shake, and he says one thing off-script: 'She was right, and I did nothing.' Beat: the enemy revealed as a coward, not a monster.

chapters.title: Burn Notice
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Retaliation begins: Ivo's scholarship recommendation vanishes, his locker is searched, and an anonymous rumor about him spreads through town—the outing he always feared, weaponized. Beat: rage and grief; invisibility stripped away against his will.

chapters.title: Out Loud
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Instead of retreating, Ivo comes out deliberately at a school assembly, reclaiming the narrative and daring the board to punish him publicly. The town splits. Beat: ferocious liberation—the moment hiding stops being an option he mourns.

chapters.title: The Recipe Decoded
chapters.summary: Dev and Ivo's POV. They realize the chat's predictions aren't supernatural—they're scheduled: the lab's systems still run automated protocols Ulyana programmed, broadcasting on a timer she set before she vanished. Beat: wonder recontextualized—she planned this for two years.

chapters.title: Where She Went
chapters.summary: Ulyana's notebook POV, final entries. She records being taken to a 'transfer facility' and hides the notebook's location in a riddle. Her last entry is addressed 'to whoever finishes this.' Beat: heartbreak and a handoff across time.

chapters.title: The Riddle
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Solving Ulyana's riddle leads them beneath the old water tower to a weatherproof case: notebooks, data drives, and letters naming every adult who signed off—including the superintendent now running for state office. Beat: the weight of holding something explosive.

chapters.title: Deadline
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The chat posts its final prediction: 'Friday. The vote. One name.' The board will vote to demolish the basement wing—destroying the physical evidence—unless someone forces the issue publicly first. Beat: ticking clock, no good options.

chapters.title: Ninety Seconds
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. At the board meeting, Ivo takes the floor during public comment with ninety seconds to speak. He reads Ulyana's own words aloud as Calloway, unexpectedly, stands and corroborates. Beat: climax—voice versus institution, terror transmuted into testimony.

chapters.title: What Broke Open
chapters.summary: Multiple POVs. The demolition vote collapses; a state investigation opens; the superintendent withdraws. But the win is messy—Calloway resigns in disgrace alongside the guilty, and some townspeople turn on Ivo's family. Beat: victory with a price tag attached.

chapters.title: The Last Message
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. The chat sends one final message—not a prediction but a thank-you, signed U.V., timestamped from a facility three states away. She's alive. Whether she can come home is another question. Beat: stunned, complicated hope.

chapters.title: Letters to Ulyana
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV. Weeks later, Ivo writes to Ulyana at the facility, telling her about the memorial plaque, the reopened records, the kids who stopped whispering. Dev helps him mail the first letter. Beat: tenderness after rupture; grief finding somewhere to go.

chapters.title: The Recipe, Revised
chapters.summary: Ivo's POV, closing. On the last day of school, Ivo adds his own entry to the dormant group chat—not a prediction, a promise—and leaves Ulyana's whiteboard words preserved behind glass in the library. He walks out with his head up. Beat: resolution—invisibility traded for witness, willingly paid.
